name: Redfang
place: stalks the scrub below Redcliff Fort and takes sentries off the wall
_doc: Stream E (M2). A great cat with a rust-red mane. It pounces from range (circle that leads its target), rakes in a wide cone, and at half health it stalks: the safe ground is the circle around a marked player — everyone else is pounced.

party.solo: Solo-able (the safe circle is around you).
party.small: Easy if you stay together for the stalk.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: Something red moves in the scrub, low and fast.
A growl, very close, from nowhere you can see.
say.death: Redfang stretches out in the dust as if it were only sleeping.
say.reset: Redfang melts back into the scrub.

stalk.name: Stalking
stalk.say: Redfang circles the group — stay close to {target}, it fears the light around them!
